question: If the speed of light in water and glass are 2.25 x 10⁸m/s and 1.86 x 10⁸m/s respectively then the refractive index of glass with respect to water is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1.21.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Refractive index **is defined as the **ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to the speed of light in a medium.**
 
• Therefore, the refractive index of glass with respect to water can be calculated as the ratio of the speed of light in water to the speed of light in glass.
 
• **Refractive index = speed of light in vacuum / speed of light in medium.**
 
• Refractive index of glass with respect to water = Speed of light in water / Speed of light in glass = 2.25 x 108 / 1.86 x 108 = **1.21**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The refractive index of a medium is a measure of how much the speed of light is reduced when it passes through that medium, compared to the speed of light in a vacuum.
 
• In mathematical formulae and descriptive texts, the letter n or n' is most frequently used to represent the refractive index variable.
 
• The amount of light path bending, or refractive index, that occurs when light enters a substance is determined by this number.
